notice:
Japanese grammar lessons written for qinqin, released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit: qinqin contributors, CC BY 4.0, [the qinqin repository](https://github.com/Elaktrato/qinqin).

The JLPT publishes no grammar list. The choice of grammar points per level and their order are qinqin's own, not taken from JLPT preparation books or other published lists; the explanations, example sentences, readings, translations and exercise answers are written for qinqin.

The levels are qinqin's estimates ("≈ N5" to "≈ N1"), not official JLPT levels. The content has not been reviewed by a native speaker; corrections are welcome.
